COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1119 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
2. Mr. Narayan Dutt, learned Standing 
Counsel for the State of Uttarakhand/
respondent Nos.1, 2 & 4.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for 
respondent No.3.
4. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioners that in the similar set of 
controversy, this Court has passed an interim 
order on 20.06.2024 in WPSS No.1022 of 
2024. Since, the controversy involved in the 
present writ petition is identical, interim order 
can be passed in this petition.
5. To this proposition, learned State 
Counsel as well as learned counsel for 
respondent No.3 have not disputed the said 
submission made by learned counsel for the 
petitioners.
6. List on 22.10.2024. 
7. Till next date of listing, the respondents 
are restrained from interfering in the 
functioning of the petitioners to the post of 
Junior Engineer (Civil).
8. In the meantime, respondents may file 
counter affidavit, if any. 
9. Interim relief application (IA/1/2024) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.)
 28.06.2024
PN

5. List on 11.11.2024 for final hearing. 
6. Interim order, if any, is extended till the next date 
of listing.

disposed of.
